RawConfig.description: Raw shape of pi-cues.toml as authored by the user. This is the source of truth for config.schema.json (generated by `mise run schema:generate`); config.ts parses and normalizes it into  {@link  Trigger } .

defaults.description: Set to false to disable the builtin walkup trigger (AGENTS.md up to the session cwd).

triggers.description: Trigger entries. Global config provides the baseline; project config entries are appended.

action.description: skill: inject a pi skill (full text). file: inject a prompt file (truncated). walkup: collect context files up to the session cwd. inline: inject the target text itself.

exclude.description: walkup only: picomatch patterns matched against the collected file's path relative to the session cwd (POSIX separators). "README.md" matches only the cwd-level file; use a globstar pattern to match any depth. A leading bang (exclamation) prefix is rejected.

target.description: skill: skill name(s). file: prompt file path(s), relative to the config directory (project configs must not escape it). walkup: context file name(s), e.g. AGENTS.md. inline: the literal markdown to inject.

tools.description: Tool events this trigger listens to. `bash` pairs with when.command; read/edit/write pair with when.path.

when.description: Predicate. Required for skill/file; optional for walkup (omitted = every listed path event matches).

command.description: Command basename patterns (picomatch; exact match without wildcards). Requires `bash` in tools.

path.description: Path globs matched against projectRelative/scopeRelative/basename bases; `!` prefix excludes. Requires read/edit/write in tools.
